title: Author ↔ Reviewer Loop
summary: Draft, critique, revise: an author agent produces a deliverable and a reviewer agent approves it or sends it back with concrete revision notes, up to 3 rounds. Works for any non-code artifact — copy, docs, strategy, designs.

standard.description: What the reviewer holds the work to
standard.default: Accurate, on-brief, clear, and ready to publish without further edits.

nodes.task:
Review the draft against the brief ({{input.brief}}) and this standard: {{input.standard}}

On REVISE, give numbered, specific revision notes.
nodes.verdict_guide: APPROVED = publishable as is. REVISE = fixable with the notes you gave. REJECTED = the approach is wrong; explain why.
